name: Paulina Barry Community
description: The Paulina Barry Community (PBC-13) was a Folk Nation street gang active in the Lake View neighborhood of Chicago. Originally formed in 1965 as a social and recreational group of youths from the Nelson and Paulina area, the group formally adopted the Paulina Barry Community name in 1969 and gradually transitioned into a street gang. Colors were black and white. The organization went mostly extinct by the late 1990s.
